document.abstract: USERS AND MANUFACTURERS of 16-mm sound projectors have long had available a comprehensive group of sound test films produced and sold by the Society and the Motion Picture Research Council. Although distribution of these films was not restricted, but on the contrary has been encouraged widely, the order of technical accuracy demanded by the specifications under which they were made forced production costs up so high that their use was, in effect, restricted to professional applications.
